system.name: MaAS
system.one_liner: Optimises an agentic supernet, a probabilistic distribution of agentic architectures, and samples a query-dependent multi-agent system from it.

content.variant_note: an operator key and a layered supernet of operator nodes from which three queries sample sub-networks that unfold into workflows of rising complexity
content.argues: One supernet yields tailored multi-agent systems: easy queries get a small workflow, hard queries a larger one, instead of one fixed system for everything.
content.subject: The operator building blocks, the layered agentic supernet and the sub-network and workflow sampled for each of three example queries.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show input-adaptive structure by drawing the same node grid once as the full space and once per example with only the sampled nodes solid; let each lane grow with the difficulty of its query and keep the operator key colours on every later drawing of an operator.
lessons.suits: Papers that choose a different architecture, route or workflow per input (routing, architecture search, agentic workflow search) and want to show that cost scales with difficulty.

evidence: the agentic supernet adaptively samples tailored multi-agent architecture in a query-dependent manner

optimizing the agentic supernet, a probabilistic and continuous distribution of agentic architectures

summary: MaAS replaces a single hand-built multi-agent system with an agentic supernet, a probabilistic distribution over agentic architectures from which a query-specific system is sampled. The figure sits in one gold-outlined rounded frame. The left side, Building Blocks, is a colour key of eight operators (CoT, Reflexion, ReAct, Debate, I/O, Web search, Evaluator-optimizer, Exit) with dashed mini-diagrams of Debate, Reflexion, CoT and ReAct. The right side shows a layered grid of coloured operator nodes, the supernet, fanning out to three example queries of rising difficulty: simple arithmetic, high-school physics and complex coding. Each query gets a sampled sub-grid with solid chosen nodes and dashed unused ones, then a workflow diagram that grows from I/O + ReAct to a complicated system.
summary_zh: MaAS 用智能体超网（对智能体架构的概率分布）取代单一的多智能体系统，并按查询采样。图左是八种算子的颜色图例和算子内部小图，右侧超网分出三条由易到难的查询（算术、物理、编程），各自显示被选中的子网络和逐步复杂的工作流。
notes: No paragraph of the paper that mentions the figure was available, so the arrows from the supernet to the queries are read as per-query sampling from the caption only. Two panels are counted because of the thick divider and the caption's Left and Right; the right half has a heading only over the supernet. model-anatomy was considered as a kind but the supernet is a distribution over multi-agent architectures, not a neural model. The prior kinds were kept and worked-walkthrough added for the three concrete queries. Colours of the sampled nodes do not always sit in the same columns as in the supernet, so no column-to-operator rule is claimed.
